description:
Publish a provider OpenAPI or AsyncAPI contract and self-verification results to PactFlow (Bi-Directional Contract Testing).

**Toolset:** Contracts

**Parameters:**
- providerName (string) *required*: Name of the provider application
- pacticipantVersionNumber (string) *required*: Version number of the provider
- contract (object) *required*: Provider contract (OpenAPI or AsyncAPI spec) and verification details
- tags (array): Version tags
- branch (string): Branch name of the provider
- buildUrl (string): URL of the CI build

contract.description: Provider contract (OpenAPI or AsyncAPI spec) and verification details

content.description: Base64-encoded OpenAPI or AsyncAPI specification content

selfVerificationResults.description: Results of self-verifying the provider against its own contract

contentType.description: Content type of the verification results

verifier.description: Name of the tool used for verification (e.g. 'dredd', 'schemathesis')

specification.description: Specification type: 'oas' for OpenAPI or 'asyncapi' for AsyncAPI

name: contract-testing_publish_provider_contract
title: Contract Testing: Publish Provider Contract
